label: Sample time
description: Each row's time point -- how long the experiment had run when the sample was taken -- as the row plan records it, in hours: the duration_hr column, read from a row's label when the plan leaves it out, and the last time point of each experiment series marked (is_last_sample). A data pack can describe what the time means in its research area (reaction time, residence time, time since cycling began) in its module settings: the description reaches the row planning as a rule.
covers: The time point of each sample (row): how long the experiment had run, in hours.

row_values.description: how long the experiment had run when the sample was taken (the row plan's time point), in hours

fixed.duration_hr: the app reads each row's time in hours by this name (row labels, series ends, figure time axes, set variables)

formulas.description: 1 for the last time point of its experiment series (its set, or its run), else 0; every row of an Independent set is its own experiment
